description: This file defines configuration options and helper functions for the otlptracegrpc exporter in the OpenTelemetry Go SDK, including setting endpoints, security, retry policies, and gRPC connection options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Interface for applying gRPC options to the exporter configuration.

classes.name: RetryConfig
classes.description: Type alias for retry.Config, configuring retry behavior.

classes.name: wrappedOption
classes.description: Struct implementing Option interface, wrapping otlpconfig.GRPCOption.

methods.name: asGRPCOptions
methods.description: Converts a slice of Option to a slice of otlpconfig.GRPCOption.

methods.name: applyGRPCOption
methods.description: Method for wrappedOption to apply its configuration to otlpconfig.Config.

methods.name: WithInsecure
methods.description: Disables client transport security for gRPC connection.

methods.name: WithEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the target endpoint (host:port) for the exporter.

methods.name: WithEndpointURL
methods.description: Sets the target endpoint URL (scheme, host, port, path).

methods.name: WithReconnectionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the minimum time between connection attempts.

methods.name: compressorToCompression
methods.description: Converts compressor string to otlpconfig.Compression type.

methods.name: WithCompressor
methods.description: Sets the compression method for gRPC requests.

methods.name: WithHeaders
methods.description: Adds headers to each gRPC request.

methods.name: WithTLSCredentials
methods.description: Uses TLS credentials for the connection.

methods.name: WithGRPCConn
methods.description: Uses an existing grpc.ClientConn for communication.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Sets maximum duration for export attempts.

methods.name: WithRetry
methods.description: Configures retry policy for transient errors.
